newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CK Infra hits high on laggards buying.
newsitem.headline: CK Infra hits high on laggards buying.

text.p: Shares of Cheung Kong Infrastucture Holdings Ltd (CKI) on Thursday hit a new high of HK$13.40 since their listing in July on demand for laggards, brokers said.
"Rotational buying for laggards fueled demand for infrastrucuture stocks and boosted their price to new highs," said Lennon Chan, executive director at Tai Fook Securities.
The company's shares edged back slightly to HK$13.35 in late trade, up HK$0.60 or 4.71 percent from the previous close. Volume was 9.27 million shares worth HK$121.28 million.
